entries.label: Clean Mid-Blue Regular-Straight Jean
entries.reason: The full source proves regular thigh ease, a straight leg and one small natural shoe break rather than a broad or puddled lower half. Correct the vague dusty-blue label to clean mid blue and keep only with S143's upper-hip warm-ivory knit plus a light minimal shoe; no oversized outerwear, bulky trainer or second loose layer. This is a visual hold only until Premium fiber, construction and customer-retail price are verified.
